source: BHVR developer stats update, patch 7.1.0 window (27 Apr – 5 Aug 2023)

items.name: Jolt
items.effect: Downing a survivor regresses all generators within 32m.

items.name: Sloppy Butcher
items.effect: Injured survivors suffer Hemorrhage and Mangled.

items.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
items.effect: Hooking on a Scourge Hook damages the farthest generator and blocks it.

items.name: Pop Goes the Weasel
items.effect: Kicking a generator after hooking someone gives a big instant regression.

items.name: Barbecue & Chilli
items.effect: See distant survivor auras after hooking.

items.name: Lethal Pursuer
items.effect: See all survivor auras for extra seconds at match start.

items.name: Corrupt Intervention
items.effect: Blocks the 3 farthest generators at match start.

items.name: Nowhere to Hide
items.effect: Kicking a generator reveals nearby survivor auras.

items.name: Save the Best for Last
items.effect: Faster attack cooldown against survivors who aren't your obsession.

items.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
items.effect: After the last generator, survivors get Exposed and the killer moves faster.

items.name: Windows of Opportunity
items.effect: Permanently see nearby pallet and breakable wall auras.

items.name: Adrenaline
items.effect: Instant heal + Haste burst when the exit gates power.

items.name: Resilience
items.effect: Action speed bonus while injured.

items.name: Lithe
items.effect: Haste burst after a fast vault.

items.name: Self-Care
items.effect: Heal yourself without a med-kit, slower than being healed by someone else.

items.name: Sprint Burst
items.effect: Burst of speed when you start running from full stamina.

items.name: Prove Thyself
items.effect: Repair speed bonus for survivors co-oping the same generator.

items.name: Dead Hard
items.effect: Dash forward to dodge a hit while exhausted-immune for a moment.

items.name: Bond
items.effect: See nearby survivor auras at all times.

items.name: Spine Chill
items.effect: Warns you when the killer is looking in your direction nearby.
